body.description: Spoutlet: a short fire hydrant creature, fat red cast-iron body, the side caps are its arms, the top bonnet is its head with determined eyes, water spurting from a nozzle, planted wide and defiant. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
